caption:
Your IIM B UGAT score is already written. It's sitting in your response sheet 👀

Results come on 15 Dec (tentative). You don't have to wait that long to know where you stand.

Paste your response sheet link at register.ipmcareer.com/response-v1 (link in our Story) and see your QADI, LR and VARC scores and your total out of 180 in under a minute. Free, no login.

It's your raw score (+3 right, -1 wrong). IIM B uses standardised scores for the shortlist, so official numbers can differ.

Comment your score below 👇
